description: Get a daily or hourly weather forecast for a location. Returns a list of forecast periods with conditions, temperatures, precipitation probability, and wind. Location can be "lat,lon" coordinates or a city name. Example: forecast({ location: "london", timestep: "1d", units: "metric" })

_apiKey.description: Tomorrow.io API key (optional — get a free one at tomorrow.io; if omitted the platform key is used)

location.description: Location to look up — either "lat,lon" coordinates (e.g. "40.71,-74.01") or a city name (e.g. "new york")

name: forecast
title: Forecast
